design: 6 synthetic cases x 2 repeats x 2 modes; paired interleaved order; 1 warmup per mode
endpoint: real loopback POST /api/interview/start; H2; RAM Lucene; test identity; no browser/WAN/MySQL
timing: nanoTime; providerMs includes network/retries/response parse, not server-only inference; API waits for complete first question
qualityRubric: predeclared 0-2 each: relevance, jobFit, depth, evidenceDiscipline; acceptable=sum>=6 and each>=1; evaluator must disclose identity
limits: pilot, no historical before/after or proven quality non-inferiority; no streaming TTFT; no price estimate without tariff; setup excluded
